mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM course c
LEFT JOIN terrain_analysis a ON a.course_id = c.course_id AND a.rev_no = c.rev_no AND a.dem_id = #{demId} AND a.sample_itv_m = #{sampleIntervalM}
LEFT JOIN dem_asset d ON d.dem_id = a.dem_id
LEFT JOIN elevation_sample s ON s.analysis_id = a.analysis_id AND a.status_cd = 'DONE' AND #{includeSamples,jdbcType=BOOLEAN}
WHERE c.course_id = #{courseId} AND c.owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} AND c.del_yn = 'N'
ORDER BY s.seq_no

SELECT
FROM terrain_analysis a
JOIN course c ON c.course_id = a.course_id
JOIN dem_asset d ON d.dem_id = a.dem_id
LEFT JOIN elevation_sample s ON s.analysis_id = a.analysis_id AND a.status_cd = 'DONE'
WHERE a.analysis_id = #{analysisId} AND c.owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} AND c.del_yn = 'N'
ORDER BY s.seq_no
